title: Subpolynomial dimension reduction in Lp
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。
status: AI 产生的研究手稿；收录不表示已完成独立审查或同行评议。
abstractEnglish: For every fixed $`1\lt p\lt \infty`$ and D > 1, every n-point subset of a real Lp space embeds into $`\ell_p^d`$ with distortion at most D and subpolynomial dimension $`d=n^{o(1)}`$. The target has the same exponent p, and the embedding need not be linear.
